title: Veterinary Help & Emergency Directory
subtitle: Quick access to veterinary officers, helplines and emergency first-aid guidelines
emergencyBannerSub: For acute bloat, severe bleeding, difficulty breathing or sudden collapse, call a veterinarian immediately.
tipBloatText: Stop all feed immediately, keep the animal standing on an incline with front legs higher, walk gently, and call a veterinarian urgently.
tipFeverText: Isolate the animal in a cool, shaded, well-ventilated shed. Provide clean drinking water and avoid giving human medicines without veterinary advice.
tipWoundText: Wash gently with clean water and dilute antiseptic (potassium permanganate or povidone-iodine). Keep flies away and consult a vet.
